## 中文原文
下午你打算完成一份工作文档。刚写了一半，同事过来找你讨论项目问题。你们聊了挺久。等同事走后，你发现留给写文档的时间不多了，只好加快速度赶进度

## My translation
I'd planned to complete a work document this afternoon.
By the time I just finished a half of it, my colleague came to me to discuss the project problems.
We talked for a while, and when he left, I almost ran out of time for the document, so I had to speed up to catch up the progress.

## Revised version
I'd planned to finish a work document this afternoon.
I'd only gotten halfway of it when a colleague came over to discuss some project issues.
We talked for quite a while. After he left, I was nearly out of time to finish the document, so I had to hurry to catch up on my work.

## Key phrases
- get halfway of it，做到一半
- come over
- catch up on sth.
